description: Deterministic safety and liveness cases for the fixed v1 direct-conversation operation-control PBFT profile.

fixed_profile.one_vote_per_replica: one value digest per pair-registry, instance, view and phase

vectors.accept: EffectValueCore excludes view and every certificate, so the value digest remains byte-identical across views; per-view envelopes bind phase, view, value digest and qDA certificate digest.
vectors.reject: A value core containing view/certificate fields, a cross-view or cross-phase signature, or NEW-VIEW that ignores the highest prepared value.

vectors.accept: A canonical qDA certificate proves durable journal availability and q COMMIT is the sole irreversible effect point; ExecutionBundle is only a validated carrier.
vectors.reject: Effect execution from a read certificate, fewer than q distinct signers, a bare journal root, self-referential certificate digest, later cancel of a q-committed effect, or a bundle treated as a second commit point.

vectors.accept: No fresh q-certified current head means pending/fail closed; after synchrony returns, exact q VIEW-CHANGE messages elect the highest prepared value or one deterministic fresh candidate.
vectors.reject: Execution from a local replica head, split-brain current heads, scanning external candidates, or deleting a post-genesis operation because the journal carrier is temporarily incomplete.

vectors.accept: Before genesis quorum no canonical operation/effect exists; after q COMMIT the stable operation and coordinates recover. Attempt advance commits before its first claim CAS and binds an unclaimed KeyPackage ref.
vectors.reject: Two genesis operations for one pair, a second claim in one attempt, attempt advance containing an accepted claim/receipt or MLS generation, or initial host head containing transfer_id.
